prompt: My landlord kept my whole security deposit in Ohio and I want to research my rights myself before going to small claims. Using Nolo's Legal Research book approach, how should I go about the research?
assertions: Frames the issue: civil (not criminal), substantive and procedural, state law (landlord-tenant), and writes a research question/goal
Recommends starting with secondary sources (e.g., Nolo, state-specific encyclopedia or practice guide) before primary law
Points to the Ohio statute/code (primary law) and reading it carefully (e.g., read multiple times, ands/ors)
Says to verify the law is current/good law (pocket parts, Shepardizing/KeyCite, law library access)
Gives search terms or a Boolean query (e.g., synonyms, Cartwheel, operators)
Covers small claims/court procedure research and/or organizing research (folders, memo) and a not-legal-advice caveat
